title.value: Language Model Alignment with Elastic Reset
title.justification: The paper discusses an algorithm called Elastic Reset in the context of language model alignment with human preferences, aiming to reduce drift and improve performance.
title.quote: We propose Elastic Reset, a new algorithm that achieves higher reward with less drift without explicitly modifying the training objective.

extractions.description: The paper introduces Elastic Reset, a novel algorithm for finetuning language models using reinforcement learning to align better with human preferences. The method seeks to minimize 'language drift' and reward hacking by periodically resetting the model to a moving average, thereby maintaining alignment with the original model's capabilities while optimizing for human-preferred outcomes.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of language model alignment using reinforcement learning, with no direct reference or application to climate change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: The rise of large pretrained language models (LMs)... made language model finetuning one of the most promising research directions to achieving capable dialogue agents.
